recipe.native_raw: No-fit cosine on same normalized physical64views. Same train-only threshold policy.
recipe.native_shift: Exactcosine native alignment maximum over block offsets -1/0/+1 with common overlapping positions on8channelsx8timeblocks. All48shift/block feature work charged; no privilege beyond same64observations.
recipe.source_frozen: Actual64->64 residual linear/GELU encoder or actual65xrank source ridge; original source PCA frozen. Source feature output ->native write projected in that frozen PCA using legal target ridge readout with intercept. Choose regularizer on T-validation normalized squaredL2 only; deterministic ascending grid ties. Same adaptation on allfour source arms; all source weights unchanged. No target gradient update of source model. Source PCA hashes of neural controls must be identical.
recipe.target_dense: Unchanged PVM64D residual linear/GELU64/128/64 transport and2-layer4head256FF residual-zero-init Transformer decoder; same AdamW recipe,2048alignment+1024set steps,lastcheckpoint. Target native T pairs only, no source weights. Context K16/32 alternating; batch4sets/8queries; CE20temperature with0.85 absence class +0.1 knownMSE. Decoder sees each query independently with peer-query mask. Cache CPU projections at inference as unchanged dense_cached_cpu algebra; no random projection or new architecture.
recipe.target_kernel: Native RBF Nyström transport with first128 paired draws as landmarks, whitening jitter1e-10;4bandwidthx3ridge grid, T-validation MSE; all gridfitwork charged. Exact64native cosine retrieval.
recipe.target_ridge_pca: Native64query->write ridge/intercept on4096draws, choose regularizer by512 reserved T-validation MSE. T-write-only PCA ranks16/32/64 xwhitening0/.5, min validation normalizedL2 deterministic ascending rank/exponent. ExactCPU cosine scan and full chargedupdates.
recipe.threshold_selection: All27 nominal T-calibration episodes (3Kx3updatesx3episodes). Prefer knownFA<=.02 and UNKNOWN>=.95, then max fullaccuracy, higherUNKNOWN,lowerthreshold.
